answer: The gatehouse is Capability token minted only after a completed verifiable task. Passing it takes each token is a finished task proven to the issuer, so a hundred fakes need a, and every alias must pass alone. Paying 113 POA once is a toll; paying it 404 times is a wall, and the wall costs 45652 POA to climb. A real river has a date on it, a real quill has a receipt behind it, and a real meadow has a witness beside it. One check, one price, one open book: the farm cannot afford the book.
